pages.text: $(bold)The forbidden ritual:$(reset) the ultimate use of the Mother Altar — offer $(reset)1x Life Fusion Ingot$(reset) as the main item and 1 item on each of the 8 surrounding altars to condense four $(reset)Forbidden Trinkets$(reset). All four share one set of extension slots; while worn, their benefits and costs apply simultaneously.$(br2)$(bold)Prerequisite:$(reset) you must first build the $(l:akaishi:goat_altar)Tier 3 Altar of the Black Mother$(/l). A lower tier will not start the ritual even with a complete recipe.

pages.title: The Four Recipes
pages.text: $(bold)Shared template:$(reset) main item = 1x Life Fusion Ingot; the 8 outer altars take $(reset)2x theme organ + 2x base material + 2x gene sequence + 2x potion$(reset).$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Touch of a Thousand Hands$(reset): left arm + right arm, base material is Life Embryo$(li)$(bold)Quickening of the Cub$(reset): 2x heart, base material is Life Embryo$(li)$(bold)The Mother's Gaze$(reset): 2x eye, base material is Life Ash$(li)$(bold)Endless Gestation$(reset): 2x viscera, base material is Life Ash$(br2)$(bold)Offering thresholds:$(reset) organs must be $(reset)tier III or above$(reset) and neither polluted husks nor gibberish; gene sequences and potions must be at $(reset)full purity 100$(reset).

pages.title: Infusion and Drain
pages.text: $(bold)Threshold:$(reset) all four recipes need a $(reset)Tier 3 altar$(reset) and a charge threshold of $(reset)800,000 life energy$(reset); the older Life Fusion Ingot recipe has no tier requirement and a 80,000 threshold.$(br2)$(bold)Automatic:$(reset) once the altar is formed and the recipe complete it $(reset)starts draining on its own$(reset) — no redstone, no player action.$(br2)$(bold)Drain:$(reset) every 2 seconds it scans all living beings (players included) within $(reset)64 blocks$(reset) and drains $(reset)10%$(reset) of their max health, up to 16 targets at a time, nearest first. Each health point yields $(reset)1000 life energy$(reset), capped at 5000 per target per strike. A target too low on health is drained dry and dies.$(br2)$(bold)Consequence:$(reset) anything drained to death $(reset)drops nothing, grants no experience and does not count as your kill$(reset); the death message says its life was reclaimed by the Mother. Creative-mode players are exempt.

pages.title: Erosion and Locked Slots
pages.text: $(bold)Erosion:$(reset) wearing a forbidden trinket accumulates $(reset)erosion$(reset), shown on the item tooltip; the higher it climbs, the more often the wearer suffers warped vision and unnameable whispers.$(br2)$(bold)Consequences at the cap:$(reset) once erosion reaches the cap the organ slots are $(reset)permanently locked$(reset) — all four Akaishi extension slots turn to gibberish, blocking both implantation and removal, and the related modification machines and the rejection neutraliser stop working. The trinket itself has become a source of contamination.$(br2)$(bold)Removing it:$(reset) before the cap, normal interaction removes the trinket as usual; once the cap is reached, the consequences must be resolved first.
Slots and body modification live in $(l:akaishi:life_body)Body Modification$(/l); organ quality and affinity in $(l:akaishi:life_organs)Organ Research$(/l).
